about_short_description.short_description: Permutive is an audience platform for advertisers and publishers to plan, build, and activate cohorts while keeping everyone’s data safe.

product.name: Halo Agents
product.description: An agentic suite for planning and executing direct media buying across publisher inventory using audience, media, and performance data.

product.name: Data Management Platform
product.description: A publisher-focused platform for organizing, modeling, and activating first-party audience signals to support advertising and audience targeting.

product.name: Data Clean Room
product.description: A privacy-preserving environment for advertisers and publishers to match data, collaborate on audience insights, and activate campaigns without transferring raw data or PII.

product.name: Curated Audiences
product.description: A service for packaging contextual, behavioral, and first-party publisher signals into privacy-safe audience deals for activation across premium publisher inventory.

product.name: DMP Migration & Upgrade
product.description: A service for moving publisher audience-management operations to Permutive’s Data Management Platform and upgrading existing data workflows.
